Research & Publications.

My research interests, published work and ongoing explorations.

RESEARCH AREA 01

Optimisation & Algorithms

My research focuses on stable matching problems, including mathematical structures, computational complexity and algorithms for finding stable allocations.

RESEARCH AREA 02

AI & Machine Learning

My interests also include machine learning and approaches to solving challenging computational problems.
